validator_addr.description: validator_addr defines the validator address to query for.

pagination.description: pagination defines an optional pagination for the request.

cosmos.staking.v1beta1.QueryValidatorUnb.title: Query Validator Unbonding Delegations Request
cosmos.staking.v1beta1.QueryValidatorUnb.description: QueryValidatorUnbondingDelegationsRequest is required type for the Query/ValidatorUnbondingDelegations RPC method

key.description: key is a value returned in PageResponse.next_key to begin querying the next page most efficiently. Only one of offset or key should be set.

offset.description: offset is a numeric offset that can be used when key is unavailable. It is less efficient than using key. Only one of offset or key should be set.

limit.description: limit is the total number of results to be returned in the result page. If left empty it will default to a value to be set by each app.

count_total.description: count_total is set to true  to indicate that the result set should include a count of the total number of items available for pagination in UIs. count_total is only respected when offset is used. It is ignored when key is set.

reverse.description: reverse is set to true if results are to be returned in the descending order.

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.title: Page Request
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageRequest.description: PageRequest is to be embedded in gRPC request messages for efficient pagination. Ex:  message SomeRequest {          Foo some_parameter = 1;          PageRequest pagination = 2;  }

pagination.description: pagination defines the pagination in the response.

cosmos.staking.v1beta1.QueryValidatorUnb.title: Query Validator Unbonding Delegations Response
cosmos.staking.v1beta1.QueryValidatorUnb.description: QueryValidatorUnbondingDelegationsResponse is response type for the Query/ValidatorUnbondingDelegations RPC method.

next_key.description: next_key is the key to be passed to PageRequest.key to query the next page most efficiently. It will be empty if there are no more results.

total.description: total is total number of results available if PageRequest.count_total was set, its value is undefined otherwise

cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.title: Page Response
cosmos.base.query.v1beta1.PageResponse.description: PageResponse is to be embedded in gRPC response messages where the corresponding request message has used PageRequest.  message SomeResponse {          repeated Bar results = 1;          PageResponse page = 2;  }

delegator_address.description: delegator_address is the encoded address of the delegator.

validator_address.description: validator_address is the encoded address of the validator.

entries.description: entries are the unbonding delegation entries.  unbonding delegation entries

cosmos.staking.v1beta1.UnbondingDelegati.title: Unbonding Delegation
cosmos.staking.v1beta1.UnbondingDelegati.description: UnbondingDelegation stores all of a single delegator's unbonding bonds for a single validator in an time-ordered list.

creation_height.description: creation_height is the height which the unbonding took place.

completion_time.description: completion_time is the unix time for unbonding completion.

initial_balance.description: initial_balance defines the tokens initially scheduled to receive at completion.

balance.description: balance defines the tokens to receive at completion.

unbonding_id.description: Incrementing id that uniquely identifies this entry

unbonding_on_hold_ref_count.description: Strictly positive if this entry's unbonding has been stopped by external modules

cosmos.staking.v1beta1.UnbondingDelegati.title: Unbonding Delegation Entry
cosmos.staking.v1beta1.UnbondingDelegati.description: UnbondingDelegationEntry defines an unbonding object with relevant metadata.
